correctness.rationale: For each 18-bit subset, identifying means 18 nonzero distinct closed-ball intersection signatures, equivalently hitting all 18 closed neighborhoods and 153 pairwise symmetric differences. The supplied verifier reads all 2^18 masks, constructs every one-token replacement, computes both component graphs and all-pairs eccentricities, and independent affine geometry construction cross-checks the Pappus LCF graph by explicit isomorphism. Independent exhaustive code reproduced 1028 minimum size-nine codes, the ten-term bipartition occupancy vector, 108 isolated slide states plus two size-460 slide components (1404 total edges), two size-514 jump components (3780 edges), radii 4 and diameters 8. Exhaustive finite proof applies to this finite graph only.
